home.title: Signo
home.subtitle: Connect Beyond Words
home.heroSubheadline: Practice the 24 letters of the Greek Fingerspelling Alphabet with instant, real-time AI feedback through your webcam. Interactive, gamified, and 100% private in your browser.
home.engineeredSubtitle: Inspired by cutting-edge computer vision and game-based learning mechanics.
home.feature1Desc: Extracts 21 3D geometric landmarks and runs client-side neural network classification with zero latency.
home.feature2Desc: Spell curated Greek words (Level 1 to 3) with satisfying hold timers, celebratory confetti, and combo streaks.
home.feature3Desc: Your camera stream never leaves your device. All computer vision and AI models run locally inside your browser.

howTo.title: How Signo Works
howTo.subtitle: A fast, beginner-friendly guide to learning the Greek Sign Language (ΕΝΓ) fingerspelling alphabet in minutes.
howTo.step1Desc: Allow browser webcam access and position your hand roughly 30-50cm from the camera. Ensure good ambient lighting without harsh backlights.
howTo.step2Desc: Look at the 3D hand model demonstrating the target Greek letter. You can click and drag the 3D hand to rotate it and inspect finger bends from any angle.
howTo.step3Desc: Mimic the hand shape with your hand. When your sign matches, the glowing green feedback and confidence ring will charge up for 0.8 seconds.
howTo.step4Desc: Spell complete Greek words letter by letter to earn celebratory confetti, level up your vocabulary, or race the clock in 60s Speed Rush!
howTo.ctaTitle: Ready to test your signing skills?
howTo.ctaSubtitle: Jump right in and start practicing with the interactive 3D hand and real-time webcam feedback!

aboutUs.title: About Signo
aboutUs.tagline: Connect Beyond Words • Greek Sign Language (GSL)
aboutUs.description: Signo was founded to break communication barriers between the hearing and Deaf & Hard of Hearing communities in Greece. By transforming traditional static finger charts into interactive, AI-guided games, learning Greek Sign Language becomes intuitive, engaging, and enjoyable for everyone.
aboutUs.card1Desc: Fostering empathy and practical signing skills for families, educators, healthcare professionals, and anyone passionate about inclusive communication.
aboutUs.card2Desc: Greek Sign Language possesses a rich, unique linguistic structure. Fingerspelling (δακτυλικό αλφάβητο) is the essential gateway for spelling names, acronyms, and specialized terms.
aboutUs.card3Desc: Powered by MediaPipe 3D hand tracking, WebGL Three.js skeletal rendering, and client-side neural network inference for 100% private, instant feedback.
